text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Fenomeno came 
to an end. And as the seasons turned once 
more, spring arrived—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, freshie! Let's go unearth 
the canned mackerel sleeping in this 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"She's dragging the freshmen around doing 
nonsense again...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will not stop you. The act itself does 
not appear to be harmful.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure that freshman girl is trying 
to get close to Gold Ship because she 
wants to be influenced by her."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This officer shall now begin patrol 
duties, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—! Boss, are you joining me today as 
well?!
choice_data_list:
Because I've decided to become an ally of 
justice with you.

Because I've decided to become an ally of 
justice with you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—From the very beginning, you're the one 
who kept my future bright and protected.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To me, you will always be an ally of 
justice, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Fenomeno moves forward as an ally of 
justice, to protect someone's future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walk beside her. As an ally of justice 
to protect her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have completed our general 
patrol—

text_block_list.name: Freshman A
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!? Golshi-senpai!? Isn't that a 
burlap sack—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we need more hands on deck...! Let's 
go grab two or three freshmen before we 
start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hate the sin, not the sinner. As an ally 
of justice nurturing the future.
